title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
description:
Working corpus record for non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts in the Modern LaTeX Editions project. The record groups Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical material as reader PDFs, combined language/corpus readers, TeX/source bundles, source scans where available, OCR/audit material, and preservation archives.

Status at a glance.

  • Reader-facing work-level PDFs: [#########-] current quality-refresh pass promoted 33 replacement PDFs after automated open/text/glyph checks.
  • Combined readers: [#########-] English, modern Chinese, Arabic, original-language, and reference combined readers remain available; older combined components are being repaired separately.
  • Source/provenance preservation: [##########] TeX, source packets, source/reference scans, OCR text, audit outputs, and superseded drafts are preserved in ZIP artifacts.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [###-------] useful working drafts; still not certified critical editions.

Top-level PDFs are intended for browsing and direct download. ZIP files contain TeX/source material, source scans or reference material where available, OCR text, repair notes, superseded drafts, and provenance. The archive is being refined toward author/work-specific pages while this record remains the coherent corpus surface.
notes: Non-European and multilingual mathematics corpus record. This version promotes the latest quality-refresh work-level reader PDFs, keeps combined readers stable while older components remain under repair, and preserves superseded drafts plus source material in ZIP artifacts.
